summary.zh: 文档修正：删除已废弃的 modelswap hook 命令的教程（该命令 v1.0.3 已移除），文档站侧边栏不再误收手册索引页。
summary.en: Docs fixes: drop the tutorial for the removed modelswap hook command (gone since v1.0.3) and stop listing the manual index as a chapter in the docs sidebar.

highlights.zh: 手册第 5 章不再教授已在 v1.0.3 移除的 modelswap hook 命令，改为说明现状并指向 FAQ 的历史清理办法（中英同步）。
highlights.en: Chapter 5 no longer teaches the modelswap hook commands removed in v1.0.3; it now states the current behavior and points to the FAQ cleanup note (zh/en).

highlights.zh: docs.modelswap.app 侧边栏移除误收的"ModelSwap 使用手册"索引页，章节列表恢复为 14 个正章。
highlights.en: The docs sidebar no longer lists the manual index page as a chapter; the chapter list is back to the 14 real chapters.

highlights.zh: README 的 Agent Skill 描述不再提及已移除的 Shell Hook 边界。
highlights.en: The README agent-skill description no longer mentions the removed shell-hook boundary.
